environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed via a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a TCP listener on port 443 performing TLS termination. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. The NLB forwards raw TCP to the Flask app on port 8080. CloudWatch logs enabled for access monitoring only (no blocking). The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/lib/app/.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener (no HTTP inspection)
